D: A Black sheriff is sent to a racist frontier town as part of a scheme to drive everyone out.
P: Serve the beans when the cowboys sit around the campfire.
S: Cinnamon apple filling in small shortcrust pies with pastry lids
Mini apple pies: Granny Smiths cooked with butter, sugar and cinnamon, spooned into shortcrust cases, lidded, baked at 200C for 20 minutes.

Dark chocolate and salted caramel ganache rolled into truffles, coated in cocoa and crushed honeycomb, packed in a little gift box with a bow. Heat 150ml cream until steaming and pour over 250g chopped dark chocolate. Stir until smooth, then mix in 3 tbsp thick caramel and a good pinch of sea salt. Chill 3 hours until firm. Roll into 24 balls with cool hands, then coat half in cocoa and half in 60g crushed honeycomb. Pack into a small box lined with baking paper and tie with a bow.
Peanuts and pecans roasted with bourbon, brown sugar and smoked paprika
Peanuts and pecans tossed in butter, brown sugar, smoked paprika and a splash of bourbon, roasted at 160C for 20 minutes.
M: Pinto beans simmered with bacon, molasses, mustard and smoked paprika

Pinto beans simmered thick with smoky bacon, onion, molasses, mustard and tomato, served in tin bowls with hot buttered skillet cornbread. Fry 200g diced bacon and a diced onion in a heavy pot until golden. Add 2 drained tins pinto beans, 400g crushed tomatoes, 3 tbsp molasses, 1 tbsp mustard, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 250ml water and simmer 40 minutes until thick. For cornbread, mix 150g cornmeal, 100g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 250ml buttermilk, 1 egg and 60g melted butter, pour into a hot buttered pan and bake at 220C for 20 minutes.
the railroad crew's supper on the trail

Rib eyes crusted with salt and cracked pepper, seared in cast iron over hot coals, with potatoes and onions fried in the butter and steak juices. Season 4 rib eyes of 300g heavily with salt and cracked pepper and leave 30 minutes. Boil 800g halved small potatoes for 10 minutes and drain. Sear the steaks in a smoking cast iron pan 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium-rare and rest 8 minutes. Add 50g butter and 2 sliced onions to the pan, then the potatoes, and fry 12 minutes until golden. Pour the resting juices over and serve.
W: Peaches and blackberries under a soft biscuit topping, sprinkled with raw sugar
Peaches and blackberries tossed with sugar and a little cornflour, covered with spoonfuls of buttery biscuit dough, sprinkled with raw sugar, baked at 190C for 40 minutes until bubbling. Cream.
K: Sarsaparilla poured over vanilla ice cream, with a dash of bitters

Cold sarsaparilla poured over a scoop of vanilla ice cream so it foams up, with a dash of bitters and a long spoon. Bourbon optional for cowboys. Chill four 375ml cans of sarsaparilla. Put a big scoop of vanilla ice cream into each of four tall glasses. Pour the sarsaparilla slowly down the side so it foams up over the ice cream. Add a dash of bitters to each. For the cowboys, add 30ml bourbon before pouring. Serve with long spoons and straws.
